freeze_timing_evidence.interpretation: Pinned driver orders setting selection, immutable confirmation-plan creation, then jobs; CLI rejects unselected confirmation settings. Command start journals and report mtimes agree. Current filesystem times are not an independent tamper-proof timestamp authority.

limits: Recorded final phase scalars, retained checkpoint names and restoration log messages checked; TensorBoard events/phase snapshots hashed, not independently parsed/deserialized.
Native-reported zero per-assay roundtrip errors and model-state hashes bound, not recomputed from weights.
State labels, transport costs, ridge state-transfer probes and neighborhood/hubness diagnostics not independently recomputed; no biological integration-validity or causal claim.

This audited integration seed reuses a frozen biological world and does not create an independent biological-world replicate. Successful fits do not establish the cause or repair of the earlier different-world baseline CUDA failure.
scope: Only the completed seed 1 scGLUE align_high fit and fixed cached baseline references. JSON/public train-val-discovery NPZ reads, public H5AD/checkpoint/native-event byte hashes and source/version reads. Counts not decoded; no truth NPZ/private/protected cohort arrays or any active fit contents opened. No checkpoint/model deserialization, CUDA, fitting, causal evaluation or state/probe scoring rerun. Only outcome-free public ID sampling and arithmetic on embedded report aggregate scalars.
